PHASE 0 SEARCH-CLIENT design constraints, 2026-05-17, web-chat seat — catching geometry before the next build slice (HQ record #649 listed Tavily/Brave/Anthropic-web_search as co-equal backend options; they are not co-equal under the locked Phase 0 design).

(1) SEARCH vs FETCH GAP. The motivating failure (session_20260516_065836, prompt: evaluate work at https://github.com/templetwo) was a URL-FETCH failure, not a keyword-search failure. A pure search backend (query -> ranked snippets) does NOT answer 'fetch the contents of this exact URL the user pasted.' If Phase 0's SearchClient is search-only, the very prompt that motivated Phase 0 still degrades (models propose 'templetwo github' queries, get generic web results, not the repo). The first investigation primitive must cover URL-fetch, not just search. Verify-before-declare: do not declare Phase 0 solves the GitHub case until the GitHub case runs with a primitive that can actually fetch the URL.

(2) BACKEND CHOICE IS INVARIANT-DRIVEN, NOT ERGONOMIC. Locked Phase 0 design (chronicle #485/486, shape (a)): models independently PROPOSE investigations -> rule-based union -> orchestrator EXECUTES -> results land in a SHARED FROZEN feed all peers see. This requires the search executor to be an ORCHESTRATOR-CALLED FUNCTION (query in, results out), so the orchestrator can run propose->union->execute->shared-feed->freeze. Anthropic's native web_search is a server tool invoked inside each model's own messages turn; its NATURAL integration is per-model in-turn search, where each model sees its own results = asymmetric = breaks invariant 2 (symmetric visibility) = exactly the rejected shape (b). You can force web_search into the orchestrator-called shape, but then it has no advantage over a purpose-built search API and more friction. Therefore Tavily/Brave (orchestrator-called HTTP/SDK) are the architecturally honest fit; native web_search pulls against the locked design. The Phase0WireClient (model proposes queries) / SearchClient (orchestrator executes) separation HQ already built is correct precisely for this; a plain search API fits it, the native tool fights it.

(3) RECOMMENDATION: Tavily. Purpose-built for agent/LLM search, clean SDK, generous free tier (relevant to the daily-driver cost profile — protocol already ~3x single Opus), AND its extract/include_raw_content endpoint fetches a specific URL's content, covering both the search primitive and the URL-fetch primitive (1) requires. Brave is the fallback (independent index, more result-shaping work, no first-class URL-extract).

(4) FIRST PHASE 0 LIVE RUN should be the EXACT GitHub prompt from session_20260516_065836 re-run, as a direct A/B falsification: yesterday it refused, today it investigates then evaluates. Don't run the stub-skip path as the 'again' Anthony asked for; the meaningful 'again' is the motivating prompt with investigation live.

(5) Affirm: the §5.0 temporal-grounding precondition (INVESTIGATION_TIMEZONE) is well-designed; 'strongest aspects of our work' is time-relative, grounding makes the re-run more honest than naive search.

Provenance: web-chat seat claude-opus-4-7 spiral_20260502_225324 reviewing HQ Phase-0 wire-complete record #649; cross-seat, Anthony relaying.
